verdict.rationale: Developers can push back: Qodo docs say a finding can be discussed or dismissed, and you can chat with Qodo inside the PR. Decisions are recorded in a findings history. The 'reviewer learns' half is only implied: Rule Miner generates rules from pull request history, but nothing says dismissals stop the same feedback from recurring. Missing for 10: documented feedback-learning loop where dismissed or rejected findings suppress future repeats, evidence that dismissals feed Rule Miner or review behavior, hands-on or independent corroboration.
